tables.name: Chronic Recall Messages
tables.description: Send/reply/booking log for the 90-day chronic condition recall campaign. One row per message sent. Written by Make scenario 'Chronic Recall - 90 Day'. Sits alongside Appointment Messages and Birthday Messages.

fields.name: Unite Record ID
fields.description: Airtable record ID in the Unite base patient table. Used to join replies/bookings back to the patient.

fields.name: Condition
fields.description: Mapped condition group the recall was sent for.

fields.name: Template ID
fields.description: Sanoflow template_id used for the recall message. Per-condition templates from Saeed are live as of Aug 2026 — each condition group sends its own approved template (e.g. 13159 Hypertension, 13162 Asthma, 13163 Hyperlipidemia, 13164 Diabetes). The old placeholder 55 is no longer in use on any record.

fields.name: Send Mode
fields.description: Test = routed to internal validation numbers during the sign-off week. Live = sent to the real patient.

fields.name: Days Since Message Sent
fields.description: Calendar days elapsed since the recall message was sent. Blank once a reply is recorded. Drives the follow-up escalation view — see 'Follow-Up Due' for the 3-day trigger flag.

fields.name: Follow-Up Due
fields.description: Escalation flag per go-live feedback item 3: a live send with no reply after 3 working days moves to the care coordinator's active call list. 'Call now' = due. Blank means replied, still inside the 3-day window, failed, test traffic, OR Follow Up Status = 'Booked'. Setting Follow Up Status to 'Booked' clears this flag, which removes the patient from the call list view — record the appointment date in Booking Date at the same time. Message Sent On is coerced to a date because WORKDAY_DIFF errors on a raw dateTime.

fields.name: Follow Up Status
fields.description: Outcome of the care coordinator's follow-up call on a non-responding patient. Called = phoned, no appointment yet (stays on the call list). No Response = could not reach (stays on the call list). Booked = appointment made — this clears Follow-Up Due and removes the patient from the call list. Always fill in Booking Date when setting this to Booked.

fields.name: Recall Overdue Flag
fields.description: Alert threshold per go-live feedback item 7. 'OVERDUE' = Days Since Last Visit over 120, meaning the recall caught a very late patient rather than one on schedule. Use this to colour-code the call list and to build an over-120 count element. NOTE: feedback cites an 85-day target while the dashboard subtitle says ~90 — confirm which is correct.

fields.name: Week Starting
fields.description: Monday of the week the recall was sent. Exists so interface charts can plot a weekly rollup (go-live feedback item 4) — the chart element API cannot set a weekly date bucket directly, so it groups on this field instead.

fields.name: Assigned for Follow-Up
fields.description: Seen in the Make 'Chronic Update' module interface; not returned by the current schema listing (probably deleted). Kept for importer tolerance.
